head: YouTube TV 1080p channels: FS1, FS2, Fox News and Fox Weather upgraded
dek: FS1, FS2, Fox News and Fox Weather now stream in 1080p on YouTube TV instead of 720p, at no extra cost and with no plan change for subscribers who already get them.
details: The change rolls out by itself on smart TVs, streaming boxes, computers and the phone apps, and most people don't need to change a setting or restart the app. A slower internet connection can still drop the picture to a lower resolution. The 4K Plus add-on isn't needed for these four channels.
where: YouTube TV in the US, plans that include the Fox channels
means: If you watch sports on FS1 or FS2, or Fox News and Fox Weather, the picture should look sharper without paying more.
todo: Nothing to do; if it still looks soft, check your internet speed.
